project.name: 健身日历 Apple 风格
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Apple HIG inspired fitness app UI — restrained, clean, SF Pro-like typography, system blue accent, soft radius cards, whisper-light shadows, editorial data presentation
project.designRead: mobile app / fitness enthusiasts / restrained Apple-like / information-dense / avoid glassmorphism or neon glow

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Apple system blue #007AFF primary, system grays for text/background, state green/red for success/error
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: soft radius 1.2rem for cards, pill-shaped buttons, rounded inputs
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: DM Sans for interface, JetBrains Mono for numeric data, clean hierarchy
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-led cards with whisper shadows, pill CTAs, clean segmented controls
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: whisper-light shadows (0.04-0.08 alpha), border-first surfaces, no glow
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal icons, no emoji in UI, clean line icons

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: bottom tab bar with 4 tabs (今日/训练/计划/更多), SF-style icons, active state uses primary blue
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single brand hue #007AFF (Apple Blue), no secondary/accent brand colors
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: DM Sans for all interface text, JetBrains Mono for numeric/spec data, type scale: display 48, h1 28, h2 22, h3 17, body 14, caption 12, label 11, micro 10
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 1.2rem default, pill for buttons/chips, slightly smaller for inner cards
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first cards, whisper shadows at rest, subtle hover lift
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: pill-shaped primary buttons, secondary ghost buttons, segmented controls for mode switching
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content, right-aligned metrics, centered tab bar

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Apple HIG inspired: primary blue #007AFF, DM Sans font, 1.2rem radius, whisper shadows, system gray palette, pill buttons, editorial calm voice
